job: Show one figure with its context and keep the detail one click away.
purpose: A framed block: a heading and description on the left, the figure and its unit opposite, and a toggle that reveals more (a table, a breakdown). It is the pattern behind "Credits remaining". The toggle sets aria-expanded and fires fd:open or fd:close.
useWhen: One number matters most and its breakdown belongs behind a click: credits left, balance, quota.
The detail is a small table or list that explains the figure.

avoidWhen.when: Several headline numbers side by side.
A figure that is use against a limit.

states.name: open
states.how: data-state="open" on fd-data-card-more; the toggle has aria-expanded="true"

states.name: closed
states.how: data-state="closed" on fd-data-card-more; its content is hidden

parts.role: The unit beside the number, in mono.
The button that reveals the detail.

keyboard.does: On the toggle, opens or closes the detail.
